steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Configure the event as a buy traffic-light auction.
Apply the first available auction pricing template; the exact reverse-auction template is not identifiable from the case.
Add the requested product with quantity 10.
Enter the requested plant/location value in the first line item's editable location cell.
Commit a 30-minute schedule starting immediately using the schedule drawer.
Invite three QA vendors for the three bids.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Submit Vendor A's bid through the vendor portal flow.
Verify the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submit the second vendor's bid through the next vendor portal identity.
Verify the second vendor bid was accepted.
Submit the third vendor's bid through the next vendor portal identity.
Verify the third vendor bid was accepted.
Verify the buyer's response view contains all three direct vendor bids and shows full participation.
